profile.headline: Software Release Management at General Motors
profile.summary: Experienced and results-focused specialist with a demonstrated history of working in Automotive industry. Skilled in Automotive products, Embedded Software, Manufacturing, Infotainment, and Technical leadership.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer- VCU Software Integration
positions.description:
ead program manager for virtual cockpit unit across 30+ global vehicle programs.  

Facilitate software deliveries, timelines and content for major vehicle milestones and launches.  

Lead program activities working closely with 100+ components and 400+ developers by establishing core teams and fostered communication through recurring core forums. (Sync-up meetings)  

Managed critical program milestones, enabled deliveries by mitigating program risks.  

Fostered strong relationships with development teams, senior management and executives through collaboration and support. (Provided program status/timing/risk across the board)  

Created, overhauled, and streamlined processes across the board to increase efficiency and collaboration. (Reduce build activity and timing by 20% by early intervention and reducing process gaps.) 

Increase efficiency and accuracy of deliverables by utilizing various process intervention, and early planning for each software cadence release. (Build variance tables, baseline software checklists. guidelines) 

Improved software delivery times and reduced risks significantly by identifying areas first and planning for it 

Advance launches of 20+ vehicle programs, and other major vehicle programs for MY23-2025 (~500k plus vehicles) 

Function as a technical interface between customers and developers while optimizing resolutions for issues with tier-1 and tier-2 suppliers, internal and external teams on virtual cockpit unit.

positions.title: Software Program Manager
positions.description:
Lead program manager for infotainment continuous improvement project and active software development projects with multiple branches.  

Facilitate feature deliveries for software from requirement gathering to design, development, and test.  

Provide inputs as CSM SME for CCB, requirement and architecture development (RAD) and other technical forums.  

Report program status, risks, and next steps to senior leadership weekly.  

Design, implement and refine processes with the common goal of delivering highest software quality.  

Stimulate cross-functional discussions on high priority defects to ensure robust design solution.  

Proactively drive and coordinate different teams to ensure each milestone is reached on schedule. 

Manage changes, risks, and issues. Ensure issues get highlighted, addressed, resolved timely and effectively.

positions.title: Vehicle Systems Engineer
positions.description:
o	Analyze and root cause issues with hardware, software and other supplier modules. 
o	Lead Display issues root cause and implementations (3 suppliers, 18+ displays, 3 variants)  
o	Act as a technical interface between customer and developers. 
o	Support software deliveries to clients and manufacturing plants. 
o	Support buy off rides and milestone build at Client/Harman facilities (8+ Plants and 20+ carlines) 
o	Provide first line of response to any major issues and resolve them in timely manner. 
o	Train and provide technical support to Liaison, Warranty, developers and Global teams worldwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer in test (Navigation)
positions.description:
•	Work in a team of engineers validating/qualifying software for multiple infotainment products for a given customer
•	Supporting in customer test drives.
•	Interfaces with the customer as needed to reproduce an issue found in a particular vehicle or system
•	Write/Review/Modify/Run-Feature specific tests, Integration tests and Partial/Full Regression.
•	Write and Run Automated tests 
•	Specific tests focused on deltas or changes 
•	In vehicle testing/Bench testing/troubleshooting
•	Defect reproduction/Verification of fixed/resolved issues
•	Developer support
•	 Creating test reports of errors with supporting traces, log files and excellent descriptions.
•	Ensures test results are documented and communicated appropriately and defects have been entered   in the defect management tool

positions.title: Software Test Engineer (Integration)
positions.description:
•	Coordinate testing efforts for six major OEM projects with teams in Europe and India. 
•	Design and implement software test libraries.
•	Perform exploratory, performance and verification testing.
•	Assist customer or developers to debug issues.
•	Support customer demo and test drive events. 
•	Perform and maintain automation tests on various projects.¬
